$description: StatusIcon (library wave 4, lane C; components/Icon/status-icon.css): a tone's icon in the tone's content color at three sizes, with an optional label.

status-icon-gap.$description: The space between the icon and its label.

status-icon-sm-size.$description: The small icon's square (16px): dense rows and table cells.

status-icon-lg-size.$description: The large icon's square (24px): banners and headings.

status-icon-info-color.$description: The info icon: the info content color.

status-icon-success-color.$description: The success icon: the success content color.

status-icon-warning-color.$description: The warning icon: the warning content color.

status-icon-danger-color.$description: The danger icon: the danger content color.

status-icon-neutral-color.$description: The neutral icon: the neutral content color.
